commit_message:
Fix command injection in in_process_run

Replaces custom argument parser with shlex.
title: 🔒 Fix command injection in `in_process_run`
description: 🎯 **What:** `in_process_run` was vulnerable to command injection due to insecure custom argument parsing. ⚠️ **Risk:** Allowed executing arbitrary OS commands by injecting shell special characters into the `process_run` arguments. 🛡️ **Solution:** Switched to the robust `shlex` crate for correct POSIX shell argument splitting.
